# Vendored dsh-usage-panel

Desktop built-in module (dsh-im pattern) for Settings → 用量统计. Not a user
plugin — the overlay rides every start (full and skip), never disableable,
never removable; missing vendor deps fail the start (desktop runtime damage).

- Source: https://github.com/AlfredChaos/dsh-usage-panel
- Upstream commit: `12ac109bc6213bdbca539e3199e7338fcac020ed`
- npm version: `0.2.0`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`)

Runtime dependency: `zod` (installed into this package's `node_modules`).

## Local modifications

- Client esbuild `external`: `react` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`. `apply` skips section registration when `Button` / `Menu` are missing (`missingPrimitives`).
- Nav label is 「用量统计」 / `Usage stats`.
- Heatmap ramps, chart `PALETTE`, provider bars, and subagent tags use `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-static-deepseek-*` / `color-mix` only. No `[data-ds-dark-theme]` in feature CSS.
- Refresh and export use host `Button` / `Menu`. Pointer-follow chart tips stay self-drawn and tokenized (official `Tooltip` is an anchored string bubble).
- Type 16/24, 14/22, 12/18; weights 500/600/700; spacing multiples of 4; shadows `lv1`–`lv3`. Motion is opacity/transform.
- `scripts/build.mjs`, `wrap-client.mjs`, and `run-tests.mjs` use `fileURLToPath` so Windows can rebuild `lib/` and run tests.
- Day buckets stay UTC (`stateVersion` unchanged).
- Projection unit uses current `stateSchema` + `wire` (not host-only `schema`/`view`); `inject` waits for `sessionProjections` / `sessionQuery` / `sessionProjectionCache` before `register`. Missing `usagePanel` cells stay pending — no jsonl replay.
- zh `fmtTokens` stays integer until 10万; empty UI only when billed `sessionCount` is 0 and `sessionsFailed` is 0 (blank-only sessions included; scan failures still show the dashboard).
- Heatmap h0 uses tokenized `color-mix` plus inset `border-l2` so empty cells are visible in light theme; legend includes the empty level.
- **v0.3 billing (local features)**: projection `stateVersion` 2 with period buckets (`costTotals`/`costByModel`/`costByDay`/`costByProvider` + `modelProviders`) — the desktop harness's projection cache discards v1 rows, so the upgrade refolds each session once (paced). Billing RPC: `session.cost` reads the live registry via a local structural cast (`stateOf` is missing from the npm rc.6 type face), `billing.get/set` now read/write the harness conversation settings section (see the price-record bullet below; the plugin-owned domain `dsh_usage_panel_billing`, `UNIT_NAME_RE`-conform, is import-only); the store starts in memory and attaches post-open (never awaits in `apply`). Client registers a settings Modal (`ui-primitives` shim extended) from the toolbar's 设置 button; `costCentsFor` gained a `peakValley` switch. The v0.3 composer cost strip (a second `conversation.composer.dock` entry) was removed on 2026-09-02: the harness's own `ui-conversation` `PeakValleyRow` already paints the same phase/countdown/session-cost line, and both mounted together after the pr-76/pr-79 merge. The billing record schema keeps `stripVisible`/`peakHintVisible` as optional legacy fields so v0.3 records still parse; the client no longer reads or writes them. The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-billing-shared` package is NOT used (absent from this harness snapshot) — its price/phase math lives in `src/shared/{pricing,billing,cost}.ts` with parity-locked unit tests.
- **Session-log auto-repair (desktop-only)**: `repair.session` rewrites ONE damaged artifact the framework flagged (decode all rows via runtime `decodeStorageRecord`, 0-based continuous renumbering, re-pack chunk runs, zstd header+event frames, atomic replace after a timestamped backup). No runtime import at module load: the harness codec is imported dynamically inside the repair path, so the standalone npm package degrades gracefully. The zstd frame scanner is a port of the persistence backend's (MIT) because that package does not re-export its helpers.
- **Paged rankings**: `sessions.more` / `projects.more` slice a full in-memory session index (ranked by tokens or by cost with the user's current prices); `projects` groups by session `cwd`.
- **rc.1 host-context bridge**: host code must resolve the caller-scoped
  `webServer` service with `ctx.get('webServer')` and pass it via
  `ctx.extend({ webServer })` before registering projection/RPC channels.
  Replay the corresponding `src/host/index.ts` patch on every harness pin bump;
  this avoids the rc.1 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`
  regression.
- **Vendored harness read faces (2026-09-04)**: host scans read `sessionQuery.readSession(id)` + the vendored `sessionProjectionCache.coldSnapshot(meta, inheritedEventCount, events)` contract (caller-supplied complete log; `cachedSnapshot(header, 0)` delta probe wrapped so it can never fail a scan). The npm rc.6 devDependency types still describe the retired id-only `coldSnapshot(id, signal)` — structural faces in `src/host/types.ts` mirror the vendored runtime instead (see AGENTS.md §6.5; the drift had silently failed every session read since the desktop pin hit dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.2). `SESSION_QUERY_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` maps to `found:false`/non-repair instead of a repair candidate, and the client's post-repair re-check now awaits the refreshed payload.
- **Price record convergence (2026-09-13)**: the ONE price record is the harness conversation settings section `ui-conversation.sessionCostPrices` — the record the composer cost strip reprices from, so it must not move. `billing.get` reads it through the `settings` service (`inject` gained `settings`; the service is declared as a structural face in `src/host/types.ts` because this package has no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` dependency and merging the service's `settings/updated` event into the global cordis `Events` map would collide with the harness's own declaration in one program), `billing.set` writes it back with `settings.update('ui-conversation', { sessionCostPrices })`, and the host-side cost ranking prices from the same cached snapshot, kept fresh by that event. The plugin's own domain is retired to a one-time import (`legacy-billing-import.ts`): legacy prices merge into the section with the section winning on conflicts, then the domain record is cleared; the import defers while the domain has not attached or the section is not registered and retries on the next `billing.get`, and it never throws into the RPC path. `billing-store.ts` is now the legacy reader only. `peakValleyEnabled` is the constant `true` on the wire — the section has no such field.
- **Flat price records carry both columns (2026-09-13)**: this plugin's per-model 峰谷计价 switch is a marker the HARNESS does not have — it reads the three top-level numbers as the PEAK column and halves them for off-peak when no `idle` column is present, so the earlier OFF write (`{ hit, miss, out, flat: true }`) billed the user's single price at half outside peak hours. The modal's OFF branch now persists the same triple as an explicit `idle` column beside the peaks plus the `flat: true` marker, `prices-source.save()` runs every write through the pure `repairFlatEntries` so that shape cannot be reintroduced, and `prices-repair.ts` repairs the stored section once — same gating as the legacy import (defers while the section is unregistered, retries on the next `billing.get`, marks done only after the write landed, never throws into the RPC path). A saved OFF entry also reopens with the switch OFF now (`src/client/billing-buffer.ts` seeds the switch and every row from the saved record; a legacy peak-only entry keeps the derived half, never a flat reinterpretation), and the single-price row is labelled 价格 with no `is-idle` colour because it names no period.
- **Official price reference table removed from the modal (2026-09-13)**: `BillingSettingsModal` no longer renders the read-only `DEEPSEEK_OFFICIAL_PRICES` `<details>` block (nor its 8 locale keys and 9 CSS rules). The price data module and its locked tests are untouched: `OFFICIAL_PRICES_AS_OF` / `OFFICIAL_PRICES_SOURCE` stay as the data file's pinned provenance, still asserted by `tests/pricing.test.ts`.
